    s = input().strip()
    result = []
    at_replaced = False
    n = len(s)
    
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        if i > 0 and i + 2 < n:
            sub3 = s[i:i+3]
            if sub3 == "dot":
                result.append('.')
                i += 3
                continue
        
        if not at_replaced and i > 0 and i + 1 < n:
            sub2 = s[i:i+2]
            if sub2 == "at":
                result.append('@')
                i += 2
                at_replaced = True
                continue
        
        result.append(s[i])
        i += 1
    
    print(''.join(result))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
